claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew is expected to land around 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT).
The recovery vessel for the Artemis II landing is the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II capsule will use a parachute-assisted landing to reach the ocean surface at approximately 17 mph.
